spans.text: “Yo nu kho, lohicca, evaṁ vadeyya: “Lohicca, suppose someone were to say: ‘rājā pasenadi kosalo kāsikosalaṁ ajjhāvasati; ‘King Pasenadi reigns over Kāsi and Kosala.
